(Fictional scene) The company is rebuilding procurement approval, with three amount bands, and has to handle delegation, overdue items and return-and-resubmit. Both kinds of ground get used, and the same person often mixes them.

In this fictional workflow, staff report long waits a month after launch. Both reviewers see the same order logs and a detailed case report. They can look for a pattern across approvals and check exactly where one documented order stalled.

Either type can recommend a simpler workflow or keep an existing control after reviewing the evidence. Those choices cannot identify ENTP or ESTJ.

In this fictional household, a relative asks whether their child can stay for a month while preparing for an exam. Both hosts have the same room, time and responsibilities to consider. They can discuss what the visitor needs and which arrangements they can offer.

Confirming a working arrangement may help the family plan. Leaving an option open may help while the visitor’s needs are still unclear. Either host can consider both approaches.

Agree which conditions need to be clear before replying and which can be adjusted later. Check the visitor’s needs before making commitments on their behalf.
